text.description_html:
Prime Hardware MDS114U15, Magnetic Dome Door Stop

There are 2 main sections to this Satin Nickel magnetic door stop. The 1-1/4" high dome style base section has a permanent magnet on the face. It is mounted to the floor with the included anchors and screws. The magnet is spring-loaded to absorb shocks. The 7/8" diameter round holder section is screwed to the door for the magnet catch and hold the door open. The magnetic door stop is made of zinc alloy and plated in Satin Nickel finish.

Also Available: Prime Hardware Magnetic Door Stops

Specifications of the MDS114U15 Magnetic Dome Door Stop:

  • Material: Zinc Alloy
  • Base Height: 1-1/4"
  • Base Width: 2-1/8"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Holder Disk Diameter: 7/8"
  • Packaged with mounting hardware.
  • Finish: Satin Nickel

Sold Individually
